basic_info.description: Nestled within the western slope of Noe Valley, this delightful single-family home is full of charm and character, and nestled beside a lush, storybook garden. The main floor offers an expansive open-concept living and dining area, complete with a classic wood-burning fireplace, original built-ins, and sweeping eastern views. Upstairs, a spacious bedroom sits alongside a bright home office with generous storage. The lower level has recently undergone a comprehensive renovation, including a new foundation and updated mechanical systems. This level features a one-car garage, one bathroom, and living space that opens directly onto the deck and gardena serene escape from the city bustle.
